_prefix: Single 2D game sprite of an original fantasy plant character, full figure, centered, 3/4 side view facing RIGHT, on a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background (no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, nothing else in frame). Painted storybook gouache, visible soft brush texture, warm key light from the top-left, cool violet shadows, thin warm rim light, no black outlines. Figure fills ~80% of the frame, feet at the bottom center. Subject:
lily_raft: WATER / aquatic. Giant Amazon water-lily pad seen 3/4 from above, flat wide ellipse, rim folded up like a pie crust showing red underside, one pink bud at the back-left as a figurehead. No face. Width 3.5x height.
